_readme: Single source of non-secret business facts for the website. Templates read from here; never hard-code a fact in a page. A value starting with TODO is a placeholder: allowed while building, a deploy blocker for production. Do not replace a TODO with a guess; ask the owner. A null value means the business deliberately has none (no public phone, no public address): leave the element out of the page and the schema, do not substitute anything.
